session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Naturally slender, delicate, crystal-light higher-mid timbre with a youthful, pure clarity, yet delivered with a deliberately cool, guarded, detached restraint. No music or background noise.
